wa.message: Namaskara, I want to know about Kisan Bandhu

hero.titleB: partner for every step of the farm season
hero.trust: 5 states · 5 plantation crops · village hubs every 10–15 villages

problem.title: Farmers grow India's most valuable crops — and still sell at the worst time.
problem.c1b: Everyone sells at once and prices fall. Without safe storage or quick cash, farmers can't wait.
problem.c2b: Each farmer buys small amounts with no bargaining power, no fair credit and the fear of fake products.
problem.c3t: Pests and disease found too late
problem.c3b: Farms are checked by eye. By the time fruit rot or pests are visible, the damage is done.

services.title: Six services. One trusted partner.
services.s1b: Genuine products from manufacturers, free and paid expert advice, pay from harvest.
services.s2b: Tractors, drones and machinery with an operator, booked by the hour or the acre.
services.s3b: Skilled climbers, sprayers and harvest crews, priced by time and skill.
services.s4b: Photo of a leaf → likely disease and treatment, checked by an agronomist.
services.s5b: Weighing, testing, drying, grading, storage and input pickup near your farm.
services.s6b: Hub operators, field agents and crews from your own villages.

how.title: Five simple steps, one partner
how.s1b: On WhatsApp, at the hub or with a field agent.
how.s2b: Genuine products and the right dose for your crop.
how.s3b: Tractors, drones, climbers and crews on time.
how.s4b: Weighed and graded in front of you at the hub.
how.s5b: Clear statement, money straight to your account.

hubs.title: One hub for every 10–15 villages
hubs.lead: Processing and services at the farm's doorstep — run by local people.

final.title: Join Kisan Bandhu
final.lead: Tell us about your farm. We'll plan services for your village and keep you posted on WhatsApp.

farmers.title: Your farm partner, from sowing to selling
farmers.lead: Genuine inputs at group prices, machines and workers on time, expert advice in your language, and a fair price for your crop.
farmers.b1: Genuine seeds, fertilisers and pesticides — no fakes
farmers.b2: Lower prices when your village buys together
farmers.b3: Tractors, drones, climbers and harvest crews when you need them
farmers.b4: Free crop advice in your language, by voice or photo
farmers.b5: A hub near your village to weigh, dry, grade and store
farmers.b6: Pay for inputs after you sell your crop (through partner lenders)
farmers.phf1: You choose the inputs you need.
farmers.phf2: A partner bank or NBFC approves the credit.
farmers.phf3: You pay when you sell your crop through Kisan Bandhu.
farmers.phf4: All terms are shown clearly before you agree.
farmers.phfNote: Credit is offered only by RBI-regulated partners. Kisan Bandhu does not lend. Interest and fees will always be shown upfront.
farmers.formLead: Tell us about your farm. It takes about 5 minutes.
farmers.waBig: Prefer to talk? Message us on WhatsApp

footer.noLending: Kisan Bandhu does not lend money. Credit, where offered, will be provided by RBI-regulated partner banks and NBFCs.
